name: resume_demo

stages.by: automatic: best passing option (no approval asked)

notes: Overhead tank 500 l, 5.41 kN full, on the stair cabin roof: +0.71 kN/m2 dead load over 7.6 m2 (NBC 2016 Part 9 Section 1 cl. 4.4.10: half a day's demand).
Grid 4 x 4 lines; 64 joints, 48 columns, 69 beams.
Fixed supports at the top of the footings, 1.5 m below ground-floor level (assumed); plinth beams at ground-floor level carry the ground-floor walls.
Walls: burnt clay brick 20 kN/m3 plus 0.5 kN/m2 plaster (IS 875 Part 1), less door and window areas; parapets 1 m on roof and terrace edges.
Partitions between grid lines: slab load of at least one third of their weight per metre, minimum 1 kN/m2 (IS 875 Part 2 cl. 3.1.2).

Imposed loads 2 (rooms), 3 (corridors, stairs, stores), 1.5 kN/m2 (roofs): National Building Code of India 2016 (SP 7:2016), Vol 1, Part 6 Section 1, cl. 3.3.1, Table 1 (i)(a), National Building Code of India 2016 (SP 7:2016), Vol 1, Part 6 Section 1, cl. 3.4.1, Table 2 (i).
Stair: 8.031 kN/m2 on plan (0.15 m waist, steps, finish) over the stair cell.
Finishes 1 kN/m2 on floors, 1.5 kN/m2 on roofs (practice).
Slab 125 mm: shortest-side span up to 2.96 m, span/depth 28 (IS 456 cl. 24.1 Note 2, x 0.8 for Fe 500).

Seismic: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016, Z = 0.36 (National Building Code of India 2016 (SP 7:2016), Vol 1, Part 6 Section 1, Annex K (cl. 5.3.4.2)), R = 5 (SMRF, IS 13920 detailing), I = 1.0, medium soil (assumed); 100% + 30% orthogonal combinations (cl. 6.3.4.1).

IS 875 (Part 3):2015 wind: Vb 50 m/s, k1 1.0, k2 terrain category 3 (Table 2, assumed), k3 1.0, k4 1.0; pd = Kd Ka Kc pz with Kd 0.9, Ka 1.0, Kc 0.9; net Cp 1 (Table 5: windward +0.7, leeward -0.3); Vb source: National Building Code of India 2016 (SP 7:2016), Vol 1, Part 6 Section 1, Annex C (cl. 4.4.2).
beam-0: 230x450 for spans up to 4.88 m (D >= span/12, >= 300 mm)
beam-1: 230x450 for spans up to 4.88 m (D >= span/12, >= 300 mm)
beam-2: 230x450 for spans up to 4.88 m (D >= span/12, >= 300 mm)
beam-3: 230x300 for spans up to 2.92 m (D >= span/12, >= 300 mm)
column-0: 300x300, largest Pu 588 kN incl. 30% for seismic moments, needs 44373 mm2 at 1% steel (IS 456 cl. 39.3; IS 13920 cl. 7.1.2 minimum 300 mm)
column-1: 300x300, largest Pu 246 kN incl. 30% for seismic moments, needs 18536 mm2 at 1% steel (IS 456 cl. 39.3; IS 13920 cl. 7.1.2 minimum 300 mm)
column-2: 300x300, largest Pu 32 kN incl. 30% for seismic moments, needs 2403 mm2 at 1% steel (IS 456 cl. 39.3; IS 13920 cl. 7.1.2 minimum 300 mm)
2 ground-floor partition(s) between grid lines stand on the slab on grade.

Stair cabin over the stair well: 4 columns rise one storey (3 m) above the roof; 230 mm brick walls on the roof beams, door area not deducted; cabin roof imposed load 0.75 kN/m2 (IS 875 Part 2 Table 2, no access except for maintenance).

Isolated footings, combined where pads would overlap, on 100 kN/m2 safe bearing capacity (brief), +50% under earthquake combinations (IS 1893 Part 1 cl. 6.3.5.2); thickness from punching and one-way shear (IS 456 cl. 31.6.3.1, 34.2.4.1); reinforcement not designed at LOD 200.
